title: Contraction-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Nonlinear Control with Statistical Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2506.15700v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Control contraction metrics (CCMs)-defined by Riemannian metrics under which a closed-loop system is incrementally exponentially stable-offer a constructive framework for synthesizing contracting policies in nonlinear path-tracking problems. However, while the synthesized policies ensure pointwise satisfaction of the CCM conditions, they may not ensure long-term optimality (i.e., minimizing cumulative trajectory-level tracking error) over both transient and steady-state regimes. Furthermore, the myopic nature of these policies could also make them more susceptible to learning biases when approximate dynamics are used to formulate CCMs. To address these issues, we propose to integrate CCMs into reinforcement learning (RL). CCMs provide dynamics-informed feedback for learning a policy that has a stability guarantee-i.e., is contraction-aware-while RL provides a framework for minimizing cumulative tracking error under approximate

translated_title: 针对非线性控制的收缩感知强化学习及其统计鲁棒性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.15700v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：控制收缩度量（CCMs）——由黎曼度量定义，在该度量下闭环系统呈增量指数稳定性——为非线性路径跟踪问题中合成收缩策略提供了建设性框架。然而，虽然合成的策略能确保CCM条件的逐点满足，但它们可能无法确保在瞬态和稳态阶段实现长期最优性（即，最小化轨迹级累积跟踪误差）。此外，这些策略的短视特性也可能使它们在近似动态用于构建CCMs时更容易受到学习偏差的影响。为解决这些问题，我们提出将CCMs集成到强化学习（RL）中。CCMs为学习具有稳定性保证的策略提供动态知情反馈，即收缩感知，而RL则提供在近似条件下最小化累积跟踪误差的框架。
tldr: 本文提出将控制收缩度量与强化学习结合，通过收缩感知策略在近似动态下实现稳定性保证和长期跟踪误差最小化。
en_tdlr: This paper integrates control contraction metrics with reinforcement learning to achieve stability-guaranteed contraction-aware policies that minimize long-term tracking errors under approximate dynamics.
